authorization: Human requested audit of one-time code/results before deletion, at least the space-occupying portions. Whole-bundle archive job stopped with nine verified BOS archives retained.

retention_policy.keep: All configurations, logs, evaluation records, reports, unknown source code and small numerical result/reference arrays. Existing full BOS copies remain recovery records.
retention_policy.delete_after_audit: Raw training/replay/chunk arrays, retired model/checkpoint tensors, generated videos/raw frames, bytecode; old orchestration copies only when byte-identical to a pinned Git blob.
retention_policy.protect: All current/held/queued work and inputs, shared environments/models, core repository code, external symlink targets and authentication material. No refresh of active folders.
retention_policy.findings_basis: docs/FINDINGS.md consolidation: DSRL has useful single-seed results; LIBERO/RoboTwin have negative or unadmitted outcomes; no proven memory/ICRL benefit. Preserve the evidence and limits.
retention_policy.review_before_prune: This audit is read-only. Review its classification and results before invoking a separate deletion step.
